title: Man buys $30 drawing at estate sale, later linked to Renaissance master Dürer and valued at $10 million
summary: A drawing bought for $30 at an estate sale in Massachusetts is confirmed to be by Albrecht Dürer. Experts attribute the ink sketch to 1503 and estimate its value between $10 million and $50 million. The anonymous buyer initially believed it to be a modern reproduction, showcasing his artistic instincts. Extensive analysis confirmed the drawing's authenticity and its links to Dürer’s other works.
